content:
# Testament of Gad — 9
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Greek MS (Codex Cantabrigiensis) | **Section:** Testaments of the Twelve Patriarchs

---

**1:1** The-copy-of-the-testament-of-Gad, the-things-which-he-spoke-to-his-sons in-the-hundred-and-twenty-fifth-year-of-his-life, saying:
**1:2** Hear-me, children-of-Gad, and-give-heed-to-the-words-of-your-father.
**1:3** I-loved-my-father Jacob dearly, and-I-loved-all-my-brethren; but-I-hated-Joseph with-all-my-heart.
**1:4** For-the-spirit-of-hatred-worked-in-me, and-I-wanted-to-devour-him-out-of-my-life, as-a-bull-devours-the-grass-of-the-field.
**1:5** And I-hated-him-for-nine-months; but-the-LORD-restrained-me, and-he-kept-me-from-all-evil-working.
**1:6** For-when-I-was-in-the-fields and-he-came-to-see-how-we-fared, my-spirit-troubled-me, and-I-threw-the-stones-at-him; and-when-he-fled-from-me, my-spirit-delighted-in-him.
**1:7** And-the-spirit-of-hatred-stirred-me-up to-slay-Joseph; but-the-LORD-of-my-father-Jacob gave-me-not-this-power, and-I-found-him-not-alone; and-because-the-LORD-was-with-him, he-gave-me-no-occasion against-him.

**2:1** And-now, my-children, hear-the-words-of-truth to-work-righteousness, and-all-the-law-of-the-Most-High, and-go-not-astray-through-the-spirit-of-hatred; for-it-is-evil-in-all-the-doings-of-men.
**2:2** Whatsoever-a-man-doeth-the-hater-abominateth-him; and-though-a-man-worketh-the-law-of-the-LORD, he-praiseth-him-not; and-though-a-man-feareth-the-LORD, and-taketh-pleasure-in-that-which-is-righteous, he-loveth-him-not.
**2:3** He-dispraiseth-the-truth, he-envieth-him-that-prospers, he-welcometh-evil-speaking, he-loveth-arrogance; for-hatred-blindeth-his-soul, even-as-I-also-looked-on-Joseph.

**3:1** Beware-therefore-of-hatred, my-children; for-it-worketh-lawlessness-even-against-the-LORD-himself.
**3:2** For-it-will-not-hear-the-words-of-his-commandments-concerning-the-loving-of-one's-neighbour, and-it-sinneth-against-God.
**3:3** For-if-a-brother-stumble, it-delighteth-immediately-to-proclaim-it-to-all-men, and-is-urgent-that-he-should-be-judged-for-it, and-be-punished-and-be-put-to-death.
**3:4** And-if-it-be-a-servant-it-stirreth-him-up-against-his-master, and-with-every-affliction-it-deviseth-against-him, if-possibly-he-can-be-put-to-death.
**3:5** For-hatred-worketh-with-envy-also-against-them-that-prosper: so-long-as-it-heareth-of-or-seeth-their-success, it-always-languisheth.

**4:1** For-as-love-would-quicken-even-the-dead, and-would-call-back-them-that-are-condemned-to-die, so-hatred-would-slay-the-living, and-those-that-had-sinned-venially-it-would-not-suffer-to-live.
**4:2** For-the-spirit-of-hatred-worketh-together-with-Satan, through-hastiness-of-spirit, in-all-things-to-men's-death; but-the-spirit-of-love-worketh-together-with-the-law-of-God-in-long-suffering-unto-the-salvation-of-men.
**4:3** Hatred-therefore-is-evil, for-it-constantly-mates-with-lying, speaking-against-the-truth; and-it-maketh-small-things-to-be-great, and-causeth-the-light-to-be-darkness, and-calleth-the-sweet-bitter, and-teacheth-slander-and-kindleth-wrath-and-stirreth-up-war-and-violence-and-all-covetousness; it-filleth-the-heart-with-evils-and-devilish-poison.

**5:1** These-things-therefore I-say-to-you-from-experience, my-children, that-ye-may-drive-away-hatred, which-is-of-the-devil, and-cleave-to-the-love-of-God.
**5:2** Righteousness-drives-out-hatred, humility-destroys-envy. For-he-that-is-just-and-humble-is-ashamed-to-do-what-is-unjust, being-reproved-not-of-another-but-of-his-own-heart, because-the-LORD-looketh-on-his-inclination.
**5:3** Speak-not-against-a-man-in-his-misfortune, lest-he-hate-thee-for-it; do-not-speak-a-word-of-him-to-his-face; and-if-he-repent-and-sin-not-again, forgive-him; and-if-he-sin-again-forgive-him.
**5:4** Yea-if-a-man-sin-against-thee-seventy-times-in-a-day, forgive-him; for-a-man-of-good-heart-who-sinneth-is-not-to-be-compared-with-one-who-is-of-evil-heart.
**5:5** For-if-he-repent-and-confess-his-sin, he-is-forgiven-of-God-straightway; and-if-one-be-shameless-and-persist-in-his-wrong-doing, even-so-forgive-him-from-the-heart, and-leave-to-God-the-avenging.

**6:1** If-a-man-prospers-more-than-you, be-not-vexed, but-pray-for-him, that-he-may-have-perfect-prosperity; for-so-it-is-expedient-for-you.
**6:2** And-if-he-be-further-exalted, be-not-envious-of-him, remembering-that-all-flesh-shall-die: and-offer-praise-to-God, who-giveth-things-good-and-profitable-to-all-men.
**6:3** Seek-out-the-judgments-of-the-LORD, and-thy-mind-will-rest-and-be-at-peace.
**6:4** And-if-ye-become-poor, mourn-not-over-much; for-through-poverty-of-spirit-one-grows-in-wisdom.

**7:1** And-when-he-had-rested-a-little-while-he-said-again: My-children, love-one-another, and-with-long-suffering-hide-each-other's-faults; for-God-delights-in-the-unity-of-brethren-and-the-intention-of-a-heart-that-takes-pleasure-in-love.
**7:2** And-when-he-had-said-these-things-to-them, he-exhorted-them-that-they-should-carry-his-bones-to-Hebron; and-that-they-should-bury-him-with-his-fathers.
**7:3** And-having-eaten-and-drunk-with-a-merry-heart, he-covered-his-face-and-died.
**7:4** And-his-sons-did-as-he-had-commanded-them.

---
*End of Testament of Gad*
